Prints individual lengths of samples, components and features

Source: R/methods-ModularExperiment.R, R/methods-ReducedExperiment.R
individual_dims.Rd

Prints individual lengths of samples, components and features

Usage

# S4 method for class 'ModularExperiment'
nModules(object)

# S4 method for class 'ReducedExperiment'
nComponents(object)

# S4 method for class 'ReducedExperiment'
nSamples(object)

# S4 method for class 'ReducedExperiment'
nFeatures(object)

Arguments

object

ReducedExperiment object.

Value

The number of samples (nSamples), features (nFeatures) or dimensionally-reduced components (nComponents) are returned.

See also

dim,ReducedExperiment-method

Author

Jack Gisby

Examples

# Create a randomised ReducedExperiment
re <- ReducedExperiment:::.createRandomisedReducedExperiment(100, 50, 10)

# Get the dimensions
nComponents(re) # 10
#> Components 
#>         10 
nSamples(re) # 50
#> Samples 
#>      50 
nFeatures(re) # 10
#> Features 
#>      100 

# For a ModularExperiment we can alternatively use nModules
me <- ReducedExperiment:::.createRandomisedModularExperiment(100, 50, 10)
nComponents(me) # 10
#> Components 
#>         10 
nModules(me) # 10
#> Components 
#>         10
